{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u021/system/state/workspace/programs/task-0454cb34.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Extend a half-width horizontal stripe, changing its missing half to 1."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    width = len(grid[0])
    half = width // 2
    full_stripes = {row[0] for row in grid if len(set(row)) == 1}
    for row in out:
        if width % 2 == 0 and row[:half] and len(set(row[:half])) == 1:
            stripe = row[0]
            if stripe in full_stripes and all(cell != stripe for cell in row[half:]):
                row[half:] = [1] * (width - half)
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    demo = [[9]*8, [9]*8, [9]*8, [9]*8, [3]*8, [9]*8, [9]*8, [9]*8,
            [3,3,3,3,9,9,9,9], [9]*8]
    expected = [row[:] for row in demo]
    expected[8] = [3,3,3,3,1,1,1,1]
    assert transform(demo) == expected
    test = [[6]*8 for _ in range(15)]
    test[1] = [9,9,9,9,6,6,6,6]
    test[10] = [9]*8
    print(transform(test))
    print('demo verified:', transform(demo) == expected)
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
